title: Design: New Inventory Part window looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test location has a default bin location, so the new part's bin row is filled in.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A white window with rounded corners opens in the middle of the page, and the list behind it is dimmed.
  • The title "New Inventory Part" sits at the left of the title row, a grey X at its right end, and a thin line runs under the row; there is no status pill between them.
  • The Description box is outlined in blue with a small blue label "Description"; the other boxes are outlined in grey with grey labels inside.
  • Under Description, in this order: Part Number; Vendor, Category and Manufacturer, each with a down arrow at its right; then Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge as three equal boxes on one line.
  • Then a heading "Inventory Tracking" with a small (i) icon after it, a blue switch that is on, labelled "Track quantities and cost of goods", and under it Min and Max as two equal boxes on one line.
  • Then Tags, then a heading "Inventory" with a Bin Location box holding the default bin, a Quantity box holding 0 and a light-blue rounded "Default" tag.
  • Under the bin row, a blue "Add Bin Location" link with a plus icon before the words.
  • A thin line runs above the footer; at the bottom right sit a white "Cancel" button with a grey outline and a blue "Save" button; the bottom left is empty.

Step 2:

  • The window closes and no part is created: the list behind it is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S13-R1: “The dialog is titled "New Inventory Part" when creating a part and "Edit Inventory Part" when editing one.”
  • S13-R2: “The title row has a thin line under it, and the close X at its right end.”
  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
  • S13-R5: “"Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.”
  • S13-R6: “The footer has a thin line above it. "Delete Part" sits at its left; Cancel and Save sit at its right.”
  • S13-R8: “Cancel is the design system's secondary button: white, with a grey outline and dark label. It closes the dialog without saving.”
  • S13-R9: “Save is the design system's primary button: blue, with a white label.”
  • S13-R10: “Delete Part is shown only when editing, to a user with the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S4-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog has a "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch, on by default.”
  • S4-R2: “The switch sits in its own section headed "Inventory Tracking", below the cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields, and above Tags (S13-R4).”
  • S4-R3: “The heading has an info icon. Hovering it shows "Tracked parts keep a stock count, with Min and Max. Turn this off for items you don't count. Untracked parts are left out of the Inventory Value report."”
  • S4-R4: “Min and Max sit in the section, under the switch.”
  • S7-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog has a Description field, followed by a Part Number field. Both are free text.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.1 New Inventory Part opens". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-01-p1-1-new-empty.png

The design's own words:

  • “Description first, then Part Number. Both are free text (S7-R1). No Part Library selector and no lookup step (S7-R2). Inventory Tracking sits below the cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields and above Tags, with the switch on by default (S4-R1, S4-R2). Min and Max sit under the switch (S4-R4).”
